title: Engwire workflow
description: One file under .engwire/workflows/<name>.json. The file name is the workflow's name, so nothing in here repeats it. A workflow declaratively composes capabilities; it carries no code. The runner does not load workflow files yet.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case. Trigger sources, plugins, actions and workflow file names use this grammar.

line.description: A non-empty line without leading or trailing whitespace. Omit an optional key rather than writing an empty string.

description.description: Summary of what the workflow does.

on.description: What starts the workflow: exactly one source, and the event it must observe. Which sources and events exist is decided by Engwire and its plugins, not by this schema.

steps.description: Run in order. Each step names a capability and hands it inputs.

uses.description: A capability as <plugin>.<action>, each half a name per $defs/name. Plugin names are one flat namespace.

with.description: Inputs to the capability, which is the only thing that knows their names.
